allowed_operation: evaluation only: fit frozen recipes on 2018-2024 once, predict 2025 once, report frozen metrics; no tuning, selection, or repair

calibration_transfer_definitions.CALIBRATION_REGRESSES: 2025 top5 calibrated LL > RAW LL; recipe stays frozen regardless

champion_policy: Logistic stays conservative SCIENTIFIC CHAMPION unless GENERALIZES is met; XGB documented as NONLINEAR RESEARCH CANDIDATE otherwise; no serving promotion in F

disposition_definitions.OUTCOME_XGB_FAILS_OUT_OF_TIME: primary delta > 0; no secondary metric rescues into GENERALIZES
disposition_definitions.OUTCOME_XGB_GENERALIZES: primary delta < 0 with CI entirely below zero, >=3/4 thresholds improve, top1 delta <= 0, no material Brier/ECE degradation, coherence comparable
disposition_definitions.OUTCOME_XGB_MIXED_OUT_OF_TIME: all other cases; in particular primary improvement with CI spanning zero, or primary improvement with material top1 regression

no_reselection_rule: after 2025 contact: no config, calibration, projection, feature, or family change; poor 2025 is a scientific result
primary_metric: mean_race_macro_log_loss_over_4_thresholds; XGB FINAL PROJECTED minus LOGISTIC PROJECTED

stage_transfer_definitions.LATE_ADVANTAGE_ATTENUATES: 2025 LATE delta > 0 but another stage improves
stage_transfer_definitions.LATE_ADVANTAGE_FAILS: 2025 LATE delta > 0 and no other stage improves

top1_audit: required; development deltas embedded for transfer classification

top1_transfer_definitions.WEAKNESS_ATTENUATES: 0 < 2025 top1 delta < dev attenuation bound (largest positive development regression)

transfer_definitions.MIXED_TRANSFER: primary delta < 0 with CI spanning zero, or non-positive primary delta with CI spanning zero and >=2/4 thresholds improving
transfer_definitions.NO_TRANSFER: otherwise (primary delta >= 0 with CI spanning zero and <=1/4 thresholds improving, or any residual case)
transfer_definitions.PARTIAL_TRANSFER: primary delta < 0, CI entirely below zero, but fewer than 3/4 thresholds improve or top1 regresses
transfer_definitions.REVERSED: primary delta > 0 with bootstrap CI entirely above zero
transfer_definitions.STRONG_TRANSFER: primary delta < 0, CI entirely below zero, >=3/4 thresholds improve, top1 delta <= 0
